edits.inserted: **成果接续流程 / Result contribution workflow，2026-10-08。** 按[贡献流程](_process/RESULT-WORKFLOW.md)先检索[成果登记表](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/RESULT-REGISTER.md)及原研究。已迁移主张只编辑其 `results/records/<id>.json`，阅读页和登记表由脚本生成；复用已有证明并在现有研究中指出新增量。别名、复查和重复验收不增加独立成果数；跨成果组合须有明确输出—输入对应。来源改变先核读再更新哈希，不能用登记标签盖过证据。未迁移成果仍以原来源为准；研究目标与其他会话授权不变。 / Search existing results before new work, identify the substantive delta, update the affected canonical record, and run its renderer/checker. Preserve historical evidence and concurrent edits. The register governs migrated summaries only, not the truth of premises or the whole research programme.

**[成果登记表 / Canonical results](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/RESULT-REGISTER.md)**：按主张复用前提、证据、依赖和反例；已迁移条目由单一记录生成。新工作遵循[贡献流程](_process/RESULT-WORKFLOW.md)。 / Start here to reuse migrated claims and identify what a new contribution adds; historical studies and full theory remain linked.

**成果记录与研究沿革 / Results and research history，2026-10-08。** [成果登记表](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/RESULT-REGISTER.md)维护已迁移主张的身份、范围、状态及复用关系；本文件继续作为跨分支导航与有日期的研究记录。[贡献流程](_process/RESULT-WORKFLOW.md)要求新研究明确复用 ID 与新增量，更新同一主张记录。 / Canonical records maintain migrated claims; this log preserves study history. The first migration contains 13 scoped results/arguments/assessments and two open targets, with documentary checks and no new theorem.

**先查成果，再说明新增量 / Reuse before extending。** [成果登记表](../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/RESULT-REGISTER.md)提供已迁移主张的单一记录；按[贡献流程](RESULT-WORKFLOW.md)在现有研究中说明复用、改变的前提或结论、真实对应与剩余连接。 / Generated views and one editable record per migrated claim reduce repeated proofs and competing status summaries. Unmigrated results retain their existing sources; the broader research scope remains unchanged.

**[成果登记表 / Canonical results](results/RESULT-REGISTER.md)**：已迁移主张的前提、证据、复用与边界由单一记录维护；按[贡献流程](../../_process/RESULT-WORKFLOW.md)接续新工作。本 README 保留理论导航和研究沿革。 / Use the registry for migrated claim identity and status, and this README for theory navigation and history.

**登记迁移说明 / Register migration，2026-10-08。** 本文保留原有主张与历史范围。已迁移主张的当前维护记录见[成果登记表](../results/RESULT-REGISTER.md)，阅读页由单一 JSON 生成；未迁移部分继续以本文件及所引原文为准。 / This ledger remains preserved. For migrated claims, use the canonical record and its linked source evidence; no historical result is erased or automatically upgraded.

**成果登记与贡献流程 / Canonical records and contribution workflow，2026-10-08。** [登记表](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/RESULT-REGISTER.md)把首批具体主张、复用别名、前提、证据和反例接到单一 JSON 记录；[流程](../../../RESULT-WORKFLOW.md)说明如何扩展、应用、组合或反驳。[生成／检查器](build_result_registry.py)与[检查器测试](test_result_registry.py)不新增 Lean 证明，也不自动更新科学回执。
